newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe reiterates France's determination on EMU.
newsitem.headline: Juppe reiterates France's determination on EMU.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe reiterated on Thursday that France was determined to be ready on time for the creation of a single European currency and said it was time to prepare for monetary union.

"I stressed France's determination to be on time for the appointment for a single currency, and I observed the same determination on the part of the Prime Minister" Paavo Lipponen of Finland, Juppe told reporters after a lunch with his Finnish counterpart.
"The single currency will be created. We need to prepare. I'm convinced that for all our countries it will be a major positive economic factor," Juppe said.
